label: Check
prompt: Grades: 40, 88, 90, 92, 95 (mean 81, median 90). Which better describes a typical grade?
choices: The mean, because it uses all values
The median, because the low outlier pulls the mean down
answer: The median, because the low outlier pulls the mean down
solution: The 40 drags the mean to 81; most grades are near 90.
explanation: Use median when data are skewed by an outlier.
